ops.body:
2026-07-26 ~15:40Z — RELEASE PHASE COMPLETE, home converging, local under formal investigation.

All five wave releases published and verified: daemonkit v0.20.8 (StableProgramFrom + policy-guarded sidecars + applyRolledBack recovery; v0.20.7 tag burned on a changelog-link release-gate miss, re-cut per the repo's own 0.20.3→0.20.4 precedent), fusekit v1.15.4, cc-notes v0.48.1 (versioned above the out-of-session v0.48.0), captain-hook v12.20.11 (pins v0.20.8, deploymentDaemonkitLine 0.20.8), synckit v0.36.3 (keyless helper agents + digest-staged helper programs, pins v0.20.8). Every diff went through adversarial review; three confirmed defects (darwinbg reintroduction, applyRolledBack gap, schema-1 migration hole) were caught and fixed pre-ship.

LOCAL FIELD STATE: applyRolledBack recovery CONFIRMED working (twice). But the keyless fix did NOT clear the local bootstrap — the same keyless plist EIOs via daemonkit's caller and bootstraps instantly by hand. Five plist-content mechanisms falsified; investigation 8841b9c0 opened (caller-context dependence), code-read lane tracing the worker spawn path. NEW finding from the direct-invocation test: captain-hook's runtimeQuiesce exactness gate (deployment.go:475) fails when the recorded activation predates an agent-shape change — possible wedge class; routed to the same investigation. Baseline caveat: the manual successes ran under an Orca app-bundle shell, not plain Terminal. Machine stable: helper up, hooks live, bundle 12.20.9, reinstall guard HARD (measured cost per failed attempt: host cycled + helper downed + no delivery).

HOME: convergence dispatched — synckit 0.36.3 + cc-notes 0.48.1 upgrades, synckitd install (decisive cell test: keyless × daemonkit-caller × plain-exe over SSH), then the cookiesync cutover (cell test for keyless × daemonkit-caller × .app — the cell that fails locally; manual keyless bootstrap is the proven fallback, Touch-ID verification per 3886b75), cc-notes package install, 20-min window. cc-pool and peer registration stay deliberately open. BOX: parked dark per user; queued baseline updated to the new releases with the hand-strip workaround retired.
